title: REQ · setFocusedObject sets and clears the focused object id
summary: setFocusedObject(id) writes focusedObjectId, null clears it
description: Context: no action writes focus. Desired behavior: setFocusedObject(id: string | null) sets focusedObjectId to id without touching state. Expected result: store reflects the id passed, including null. Why: the keyboard handler and scene need one write path.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, when setFocusedObject('bookshelf') is called, then focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'
Given focus is 'bookshelf', when setFocusedObject(null) is called, then focusedObjectId is null
Given an initialized state, when setFocusedObject('door') is called, then state is the same object as before

out_of_scope: validating the id against scene objects

technical_constraints: Action uses zustand set with a partial update
